text.card: Kepler-7 is a 5,933 K star 923 parsecs away with 1 known transiting planet.
text.introduction: Kepler-7 is a star of 5,933 K 923 parsecs away. Its planet Kepler-7 b crosses it, which is how it was found and sized.

quotes.title: Kepler-7
quotes.card: Kepler-7 is a star located in the constellation Lyra in the field of view of the Kepler Mission, a NASA operation in search of Earth-like planets.
quotes.introduction: It is home to the fourth of the first five planets that Kepler discovered; this planet, a Jupiter-size gas giant named Kepler-7b, is as light as styrofoam.
